root_idea.summary: The root denotes raising or elevating, as opposed to lowering or putting down.
root_idea.development: From physical elevation, the lexical field extends to making something high in rank or esteem, bringing it forward or near, making it known or attributing it to a source, and in some constructions removing or withdrawing it.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The canonical Form I verb is a distinct Quranic lexical form.
These are feminine inflections of the same passive-participial lexeme مَرْفُوع, not a separate dictionary headword.
The active participle is substantivized in its Quranic occurrence and has a distinct form-level use.
Adjectival رَفِيع is a distinct lexical form.
The feminine active participle is substantivized as a distinct Quranic noun.

senses.definition: To raise, elevate, or lift a physical thing or person, including to rear or make a structure high.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for raising something from its resting place, making it high, and in constructions with an object raised above or toward a higher place.

senses.definition: To elevate in rank, dignity, esteem, or fame; to raise someone's standing or renown.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative use for elevation of status, degrees, honor, or mention; it can also express holding someone or something above a lower matter.

senses.definition: To accept and honor a righteous work, or to cause good speech to ascend toward acceptance.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic construction in which يَرْفَعُهُ is interpreted either as divine acceptance of righteous work or as righteous work raising good speech to acceptance.
Used of things physically elevated or placed above others, including the raised heavens and elevated furnishings.

senses.definition: Honored, exalted, or high in estimation.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative interpretation in which elevation denotes distinction, honor, or elevated status.

senses.definition: Brought near or made readily presented to those concerned.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially in the interpretation of مَرْفُوعَةٍ in the expression وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ; this is a conventional extension of raising to bringing near.

senses.definition: One who raises or elevates; in the Quranic construction, the one who raises Jesus to God.
senses.usage_conditions: The raising in 3:55 is explained as physical elevation to heaven and/or elevation through distinction and honor.

senses.definition: High, exalted, or elevated in rank, dignity, or attributes.
senses.usage_conditions: In رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ, it describes exalted degrees or attributes and may also be understood as the one who exalts the degrees of the believers.

senses.definition: That which raises or elevates; in the Quranic expression, a raising of people in rank or status.
senses.usage_conditions: In خَافِضَةٌ رَافِعَةٌ, the active participle is substantivized and describes the contrasting elevation of status in the eschatological scene.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove or transport harvested grain from the place of reaping to the threshing floor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural use, also naming the days on which harvested produce is carried.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The storing-up of harvested grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for storage after the produce has been gathered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look toward someone or pay regard or attention to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom of not raising one's head toward a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring something into view or make a distant figure appear elevated to the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an object that seems to rise into view and of a mirage that visually elevates or magnifies a distant figure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring or present a person before a ruler or judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional legal or administrative construction with إلى and an authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring forward or adduce a text or argument against an authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression of bringing the Quran against a ruler, it means interpreting or applying it as grounds for opposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trace a person's lineage upward to an ancestor, tribe, city, or other origin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional genealogical use synonymous with assigning or relating a lineage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trace or attribute a report to its author or ultimate transmitter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of tracing a tradition through its transmitters to the Prophet or another source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a matter known, report it, or refer it to an administrator, ruler, or judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Covers reporting against someone and submitting or appealing a case or matter to an authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have an objective proposed and aspire toward it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic construction in which a goal is raised before someone as an object of ambition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a camel or other beast exert itself to the utmost or go at great speed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of urging an animal into the pace called مَرْفُوع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To press someone to the utmost limit of what he knows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized questioning or inquiry construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stir up a fire and make it burn strongly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of causing something to rise or flare.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to draw up or withhold her milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when milk or colostrum is retained in the udder rather than yielded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put away, preserve, store, or lay an object in a repository.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use for placing something into a chest, storeroom, or closet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To maintain severe discipline or beat and chastise persistently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom about not removing the staff from one's shoulder or household; it is not a literal statement about the staff's position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undertake many journeys or be constantly traveling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative idiomatic interpretation of the same staff expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For legal or moral recording to be suspended for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The idiom concerns the sleeper, the temporarily incapacitated or insane person, and the child until maturity; nothing is recorded for or against them during the stated condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw, remove, do away with, annul, revoke, or remit something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of removing distress or punishment and of putting away an existing condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give over or relinquish war; in an exceptional contrary usage, to raise or make war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary interpretation treats war as put away, while one cited usage employs the expression in the opposite sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exclude a way or passage from among the portions or shares of land or a house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized division-of-property construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise or advance something progressively, part by part.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II use emphasizes successive advancement or raising.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put, send, or advance people or a matter forward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of sending people forward to battle or bringing an affair forward to a commander.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ass, to run with one part of its pace quicker than another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an uneven or variably rapid run.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To try by every means to turn or induce someone, including by deceit or guile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal or causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spare, pardon, leave unmolested, or make peace with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the sense of leaving someone alone or reconciling with him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exalt oneself, become haughty, or disdain something as beneath oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form V reflexive use expresses self-elevation and disdain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For two parties to bring their opposing complaints or cases before a ruler or judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal legal construction involving mutual presentation or communication of each party's case.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise, become elevated, or be taken away or removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intransitive or quasi-passive counterpart of raising; of physical things it can mean rising from a resting place or going away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For rank, value, or standing to become high or eminent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative intransitive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To advance into a sitting-place, room, or assembly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This imperative conventional use does not refer to physical height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the morning or day to advance as the sun rises higher.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal use describing the progress of the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a price to rise or advance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional economic use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To depart or remove from a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive movement-away use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a disease, pain, or affliction to leave or abate from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional intransitive use of withdrawal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In technical logic, for two contradictories not to be simultaneously nonexistent in the same thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized logical expression concerning the two alternatives of existence and nonexistence, or motion and rest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire, demand, or ask that something be raised, elevated, taken up, or removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X request construction, including asking that hands be raised for supplication.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For what is on a table to be consumed and ready to be cleared away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use implying that the table's contents are due to be removed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or exalted rank, condition, or state; nobility and honor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting elevation of status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fine, delicate, thin, or fine-textured when applied to a garment or cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material-quality use distinct from elevation in rank.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High, loud, or strong in voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person's voice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pace in which a beast is made to exert itself to the utmost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of rapid animal movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A string by which a shackled person raises his shackles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material implement attached to a fetter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A device used to make a woman's buttocks appear larger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An article of bodily padding; its plural is رَفَائِعُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A case or claim communicated or submitted to a legal administrator.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun for a matter brought before an authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who traces traditions to the Prophet or his Companions, or communicates them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agent noun connected with attribution and transmission of reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Exalter, as a divine name: the one who raises the believer through prosperity and the saints through teaching.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A theological epithet rather than the ordinary active participle alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, one that withholds or does not yield her milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for the animal's withholding of milk or colostrum.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person going upward or traveling through lands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of one moving through countries.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rising lightning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use describing lightning's upward appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People traveling at the rapid pace called مَرْفُوع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural nominal use connected with the specialized pace of camels or beasts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land difficult to irrigate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized geographical expression, contrasted with land easy to irrigate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard, elevated tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized feminine adjective used as a terrain term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Higher, more elevated, or highest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The comparative or superlative adjective of elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More skilled at tracing or attributing a tradition to its author.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative technical use in hadith transmission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Faster than another part of the same run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an animal's unevenly varying pace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of elevation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic place noun also extended to an elevated seat or throne.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chair or throne.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object placed at an elevated position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An implement used to raise, elevate, or take something up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A specialized rapid pace of a horse, camel, or other beast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A gait above the ordinary easy pace and below the more extreme running paces described in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or elevated, as a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive participial adjective describing physical height.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a people or company to go upward or travel through lands.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use describing people moving upward or through countries.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a camel or other beast to exert itself to the utmost or go at a rapid pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use describing the animal's own effort or pace; the pace is called مَرْفُوع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become high, exalted, noble, or eminent in rank, condition, or state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A stative Form I use describing elevation in rank, including high standing in lineage or grounds of honor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a garment or piece of cloth, to be fine, delicate, thin, or fine in texture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A stative Form I use describing the material quality of cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become high or loud in voice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A stative Form I use describing the height or loudness of a voice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tradition attributed by a Companion to the Prophet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical passive-participial use in hadith terminology, whether the Prophet is named directly or the chain is traced up to him.

cautions: The Quranic phrase بَلْ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ is explicitly presented with both physical-elevation and honor-based interpretations; it is therefore represented under both corresponding verb senses.
The interpretations of وَفُرُشٍ مَرْفُوعَةٍ include physical elevation, honor, and bringing near; these alternatives are retained as distinct but related senses.
